name: jaeger-ide
description: A local IDE conversation surface for your persistent Jaeger Gateway.

chatParticipants.name: jaeger
chatParticipants.description: Jaeger AI conversation and agent workspace

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Run the project verification test suite

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check Jaeger Gateway and agent health

jaeger.testCommand.description: Optional custom command to run for the verification test suite (e.g. 'npm test', 'pytest', 'cargo test'). User settings only: a workspace cannot choose a shell command.

jaeger.autoStartGateway.description: Start a local Jaeger Gateway daemon when the panel opens and none is answering. User settings only.

jaeger.gatewayUrl.description: Gateway URL for this device (e.g. "http://127.0.0.1:8810" or Tailscale host "http://home-mac.ts.net:8810"). Per-device connection setting; not synced across devices.

jaeger.callerToken.description: Optional Gateway caller token fallback. Use "Jaeger: Set Caller Token" to store your token securely in OS SecretStorage instead of settings. Not synced across devices.

jaeger.model.description: Default provider/model for new turns ("provider::model" or "@provider:model"). Eligible for Settings Sync when user-settings sync is enabled and this key is not excluded. Validated against the connected Gateway catalog; empty preserves the server/Gateway default.
